access_token.description: The access token string as issued by the authorization server. (required)

token_type.description: The type of token this is, typically just the string “bearer”. (required)

expires_in.description:
If the access token expires, the server should reply with the duration of time in seconds
the access token is granted for. (recommended)

refresh_token.description:
Useful to obtain another access token. However, tokens issued with the implicit grant cannot be
issued a refresh token. (optional)

scope.description:
If the scope the user granted is identical to the scope the app requested, this parameter is optional.
If the granted scope is different from the requested scope, such as if the user modified the scope,
then this parameter is required.

title:
When responding with an access token, the server must also include the additional Cache-Control: no-store and
Pragma: no-cache HTTP headers to ensure clients do not cache this request.
name: OAuthAccessTokenResponse
